Gifted: Disintegration.description:
🧬 Disintegration, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you crumble a weapon, a lock or a shield in a moment, and you can hold the decay to a thin line that cuts a trapped person free.
📈 With training: swung weapons dusted, floors crumbled under a gang, walks through walls, collapses lifted off the trapped, structures dropped exactly where you choose.
⚠️ On a living person it maims or kills, so every lawful use is on matter.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the decay creeps past where you meant it to stop.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tomura Shigaraki (Decay), Overhaul (Overhaul).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Disintegration.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Disintegration family): Scale: the user breaks down nonliving matter under a full hand. A new adult user turns a pistol to grit in a moment, a door in seconds; decay spreads about a meter through joined matter. On a person it destroys gripped flesh; held past a moment it maims or kills; decay through ground or walls stops at living flesh. More needs techniques. Limits: bound or gloved hands, a broken grip or distance stop it; it cannot repair or undo; falling debris endangers those below. Quirk Strain: light: grip, narrow cut; moderate: dusting a weapon, crumbling a floor, walking through walls; heavy: clearing rubble, dropping part of a building; severe: signature, unmaking named things through a structure. Type: Emitter. Law: use on a person is charged as grievous assault or attempted murder, so licensed users work on matter only (breaching, demolition, rescue); police treat unlicensed users as armed.
